notes: Exhaustive GraphQL API scan found and live-verified two new real data sources: Active IQ's own official Health Score (summary.healthScore, 0-100 with a 9-factor KPI breakdown) and per-aggregate storage detail (efficiency, FabricPool, dedup-disabled volumes -- populated on 130/484 systems tested). Both now integrated (Overview KPI, QBR Pack, Risk & Remediation Brief). A follow-up deliverables audit for fabricated/irrelevant data found and fixed a duplicate undocumented sustainability-score heuristic in the Risk & Remediation Brief, a mislabeled 'incidents prevented' metric in the MSP Service Report, and added real Success Plan alignment references to the QBR Pack, Risk & Remediation Brief, and Account Handover Brief (previously none of the 7 deliverables mentioned Success Plans at all). Also added a Success Plan suggestion system: 6 templates evaluate each real customer's real data and surface only genuinely-triggered suggestions, adoptable in bulk via the real createSuccessPlan write-back, with real progress tracking (local baseline-to-current delta on the real trigger metric, since Active IQ's Success Plan object has no progress field of its own).
